title: Avomi FLIQ Prefilled Vape Pods - Menthol Tobacco
description: The Avomi Fliq 4-in-1 Replacement Prefilled Pods in Menthol Tobacco flavour deliver a satisfying fusion of rich, smooth tobacco and fresh, cool menthol, perfect for vapers who enjoy a balanced, refreshing vape. Each pod is prefilled with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, designed for a smooth throat hit and fast-acting nicotine relief. These replacement pods are compatible with the Avomi Fliq 4-in-1 Prefilled Pod Device, which allows users to switch between four flavours for a dynamic vaping experience that can be adapted at any time to your mood or taste preference. The device is easy to use, requiring only a quick swap of pods to change up your flavours. With a 950mAh rechargeable battery and USB-C fast charging, the Avomi Fliq 4-in-1 device is both convenient and versatile. The ergonomic design and soft-touch coating ensure comfort and ease of use throughout the day.
